foodOn.label: garlic clove

citation.source: FoodOn (foodon.org), an OBO Foundry ontology, CC BY 4.0. Matched via EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) search API against the live FoodOn ontology, verified 2026-08-19.

foodOn.note: FOODON:00003582 "garlic bulb" was the more literal top search hit, but this repo models garlic at CLOVE granularity throughout (see garlic_peel.json's own citation in REFERENCES.md, "the single-CLOVE granularity garlic.json is actually modeled at") -- the clove class matches this repo's actual scope, the bulb class would not.
